diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- NUBE Y LLUVIA (Más hacia el fondo en Z para que no tape los libros) -->
    <a-entity id="nube" position="-0.2 2.5 -1" animation="property: position; to: 0.2 2.5 -1; dir: alternate; dur: 3000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Nubes -->
        <a-sphere position="0 0 0" radius="0.5" color="#94a3b8"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="0.4 -0.1 0.1" radius="0.4" color="#cbd5e1"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="-0.4 -0.1 0.1" radius="0.4" color="#cbd5e1"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="0.2 0.2 0" radius="0.35" color="#e2e8f0"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="-0.2 0.2 0" radius="0.35" color="#e2e8f0"></a-sphere>
        
        <!-- Lluvia -->
        <a-cylinder position="-0.3 -0.5 0" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: -0.3 -2.5 0; dur: 400; loop: true; easing: linear"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="0.1 -0.4 0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: 0.1 -2.5 0.1; dur: 450; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 100"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="-0.1 -0.6 -0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: -0.1 -2.5 -0.1; dur: 380; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 200"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="0.3 -0.5 -0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: 0.3 -2.5 -0.1; dur: 420; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 50"></a-cylinder>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- LIBROS FLOTANTES MAGICOS -->
    <!-- Libro Rojo (A la Izquierda) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.5 -0.5 0" rotation="10 30 -15" animation="property: position; to: -3.5 0.2 0; dir: alternate; dur: 2500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Portada -->
        <a-box width="1.2" height="1.6" depth="0.25" color="#dc2626"></a-box>
        <!-- Páginas blancas -->
        <a-box width="1.1" height="1.5" depth="0.27" color="#f8fafc" position="0.05 0 0"></a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- Libro Azul (A la Derecha) -->
    <a-entity position="3.5 -0.5 0.5" rotation="-15 -20 15" animation="property: position; to: 3.5 0.5 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 3000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Portada -->
        <a-box width="1.2" height="1.6" depth="0.25" color="#2563eb"></a-box>
        <!-- Páginas blancas -->
        <a-box width="1.1" height="1.5" depth="0.27" color="#f8fafc" position="-0.05 0 0"></a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- EL TEXTO FLOTANTE BRILLANTE (En el centro) -->
    <a-entity position="0 0 0.5" animation="property: position; to: 0 0.2 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 2000; loop: true">
        
        <!-- EFECTO DE BRILLO: Texto azul eléctrico inflado un poco atrás -->
        <a-text 
            value="¡Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de la\nMetodologia de la Investigacion!" 
            color="#0ea5e9" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.05"
            line-height="60"
            position="0.03 -0.03 -0.05">
        </a-text>

        <!-- TEXTO PRINCIPAL: Blanco y nítido al frente -->
        <a-text 
            value="¡Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de la\nMetodologia de la Investigacion!" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="5"
            line-height="60"
            position="0 0 0">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
